frame: X = flat-pattern X (left edge of the lower tab at x=0). Main wall stands in the XZ plane at y 0..3. The high tab (Ø6.8) extends toward -Y at the top, z 33.9..36.9. The low flange (2x Ø7) extends toward +Y at the bottom, z 0..3. Z is up.
body: High tab: x 0..18, y -19.97..3, z 33.9..36.9 (bend down at flat y=16.6)
Vertical S-wall: y 0..3. Its flat outline between the bend lines (flat y 16.6..47.8) maps to z 36.9..0. It has an R15 outer corner on the left and an R22 sweep on the right.
Low flange: z 0..3, x 47..70, y 0..53.07. The right edge steps from 65 to 70 and the left edge from 47 to 52 (R25 blends).
Upright tab: x 49..52, y 40.07..53.07, z 0..30.2 (bend up R1 at flat x~51.7)
